metaData.title: EVA-Bench Data 2.0: 3 Domains， 121 Tools， 213 Scenarios
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: EVA-Bench Data 2.0 expands its enterprise voice agent benchmark to three domains (Airline CSM, ITSM, Healthcare HRSD) with 213 scenarios across 121 tools, detailing a rigorous joint generation and validation process for reproducible evaluation.
metaData.summary: This article announces the release of EVA-Bench Data 2.0, a significant expansion of the enterprise voice agent benchmark. It introduces two new domains—Enterprise IT Service Management (ITSM) and Healthcare HR Service Delivery (HRSD)—alongside the original Airline Customer Service Management (CSM), totaling 213 evaluation scenarios across 121 tools. The post details five core design principles: voice-first scope, realism, variety, authentication, and reproducibility. It explains the joint generation process using the SyGra pipeline, which creates three interdependent components (user goal, initial database, expected final state) in a single pass to ensure consistency. A multi-stage validation loop, including structural checks, LLM-based consistency checks, and trace verification, is described. The article also covers manual review and a final frontier model validation pass. Deep dives into the ITSM and HRSD domains highlight their unique challenges, such as complex policy hierarchies and domain-specific terminology. Finally, it previews upcoming multilingual support, adapting scenarios for languages like French with localized names, locations, and phone numbers. The dataset, evaluation framework, and leaderboard are all open-source.

mainPoints.point: EVA-Bench 2.0 scales to 213 scenarios across 3 enterprise domains, a 4x increase.
mainPoints.explanation: The benchmark now covers Airline CSM (50), ITSM (80), and Healthcare HRSD (83) scenarios, testing agent adaptability to diverse vocabularies, workflows, and policies.

mainPoints.point: Joint generation of user goal, database, and ground truth ensures reproducibility.
mainPoints.explanation: The SyGra pipeline produces three interdependent components together, preventing silent inconsistencies. The user goal is a decision tree, not a vague intent, ensuring consistent simulator behavior.

mainPoints.point: Rigorous multi-stage validation eliminates ambiguous or unsolvable scenarios.
mainPoints.explanation: Validation includes structural checks, LLM-based consistency checks, and trace verification. A final pass with three frontier models ensures all scenarios are solvable by at least one model.

mainPoints.point: New domains target distinct failure modes for voice agents.
mainPoints.explanation: ITSM focuses on complex policy hierarchies and multi-step troubleshooting, while Healthcare HRSD introduces domain-specific terminology (NPI, FMLA) and strict compliance requirements.

mainPoints.point: Multilingual support is being added for realistic cross-language evaluation.
mainPoints.explanation: The upcoming extension adapts not just language but also localized names, locations, and phone numbers to provide an authentic experience in each target language and culture.

keyQuotes: Together they span 213 evaluation scenarios across 121 tools, a roughly 4x increase in scenario coverage from our original release.
Reproducibility requires that the user simulator behaves the same way every time a scenario is run. A vague statement of intent does not achieve this.
Joint generation is essential because these three components are deeply interdependent. Independent generation would introduce silent inconsistencies.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing workspace agents in ChatGPT
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces workspace agents, a new class of shared, long-running AI agents within ChatGPT for business teams, designed to automate complex workflows, integrate with organizational tools, and operate under enterprise-grade controls.

relatedArticles.title: Codex Now Integrates Directly with Chrome on macOS and Windows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces a new Chrome extension for Codex on macOS and Windows, enabling the AI to operate directly within a user's live browser session to perform complex, parallel automation tasks using their active profile and direct code execution.

relatedArticles.title: Specialization Beats Scale: A Strategic Variable Most AI Procurement Decisions Overlook
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A 3-billion-parameter specialized model outperformed every commercial frontier API in a structured OCR benchmark at roughly fifty times lower cost, demonstrating that distributional alignment to the deployment task can be more decisive than parameter count.

relatedArticles.title: Falcon Perception
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Falcon Perception is a 0.6B early-fusion Transformer that unifies vision and language in a single backbone for open-vocabulary grounding and segmentation, outperforming SAM 3 on complex compositional prompts.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Long-Context Multimodal Intelligence for Documents， Audio and Video Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, a new open-weight omni-modal model that combines text, image, video, and audio understanding with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-MoE backbone, achieving top accuracy on multiple multimodal leaderboards while delivering up to 9x higher throughput.

relatedArticles.title: How NVIDIA AI-Q Reached \#1 on DeepResearch Bench I and II
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: NVIDIA AI-Q achieves state-of-the-art performance on deep research benchmarks through a modular multi-agent architecture, fine-tuned Nemotron-3 models, and specialized reliability middleware.

relatedArticles.title: Building a Fast Multilingual OCR Model with Synthetic Data
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details NVIDIA's development of Nemotron OCR v2, a fast and accurate multilingual OCR model trained on a massive, open-source synthetic dataset of 12.2 million images, overcoming data scarcity through a scalable, language-agnostic rendering pipeline.

relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Andrej Karpathy explores the paradigm shift from manual programming to agent orchestration, the automation of AI research, and the profound implications for software engineering and education.

relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI announces GPT-5.5, a new model designed for complex goal understanding and autonomous task completion, now available in ChatGPT and Codex.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.5, a new category of AI that acts as an autonomous agent capable of planning, reasoning, and executing complex multi-step tasks across different applications.
